Text: We pray to you, Lord. Dwell in this place with us. Make it a safe refuge by driving away all snares and schemes of the enemy. [t] Let Your holy Kingdom rest here, and guard us in peace. [*] Place Your blessing forever upon and within us

Extra.BreviaryInstructions: For the Easter Triduum, and Solemnities occurring during the week.
